_comment: sg13g2-lc-pll supply/connectivity ERC spec, T1 item 11 (#344 writes it, #38 grades it).
Layers are the IHP SG13G2 numbers pinned for this repo (GatPoly 5/0 + Activ 1/0, Cont 6/0,
pSD 14/0, NWell 31/0, Metal1..Metal5 8/10/30/50/67, TopMetal1 126, TopMetal2 134; vias
19/29/49/66/125/133), per layout/gen_top.py LAYERS and layout/gen_integrated.py METALS.
Label scope: net names are read only from the pin purposes 8/25 (Metal1) and 67/25 (Metal5)
where every top-level route and cell port label sits. The VCO cell's internal 134/25 'VDD'
text is deliberately NOT in scope (no topmetal2 label_layer): the island it names is the
VDDV branch of spec section 5, named by the VDDV landing label on 67/25, and the VCO's own
naming of its supply must not be read as a tie between top-level VDD and VDDV. VDDV is
declared with no same_net_as: a drawn VDD-VDDV short must stay an erc.supply_short finding.

nets.name: VDDV
nets._comment: VCO core branch (spec section 5): the TopMetal2 strap from its labelled landing to the VCO's VDD bar. One island: landing tower + strap + VCO bar.

nets.name: VDD
nets._comment: prescaler, PFD, charge pump, divider (+ M2/M3/A2 tie-offs), lock detector. One star from its labelled landing.

nets.name: VSS
nets._comment: One drawn return for every block plus the divider M0/M1/A0/A1 tie-offs and the top-level p+ guard ring. Spec section 5's separate quiet/digital returns are NOT yet drawn: this single island is the honest state, stated in layout/README.md.

nets.name: IREFCP
nets._comment: external charge-pump bias current to lcpll_cp.IREF

ties.name: guard_ring
ties._comment: The top-level p+ guard ring gen_top.py draws around the keep-out (Activ/pSD/Cont/Metal1 annulus, inner edge VCO bbox + 25 um, 1 um wide, pSD 0.3 larger). Four arm boxes, one per arm; the tap is the ring's Cont-on-pSD row, tied to VSS by the route stack gen_integrated.py lands on the south arm.

ties_disclosure.reason: Tie classes this first supply run (#344) does not declare, all cleared by drawing rather than by a tool change: loop-block NWell taps (the pfet groups of the placement-only cells carry no tap rings yet, a #343 follow-up); the cell-internal pSD substrate tap rings of the placement-only cells (untied by a route inside the cells, #343's boundary); and the VCO's substrate/well tie (the ground pin '0' is unreachable at top level without forbidden metal, 2AMLogic/sg13g2-vco#427).
